findings.title: Slot campaign id deviates from the spec's wording
findings.detail: The spec says to take the slot with campaign id = the job's campaign. _run_gates uses `remote:<campaign>` instead. The deviation is written up in 'As shipped' and tested (test_held_slot_gives_slot_wait_then_started asserts the waiter is `remote:C-1`), so it is a documented choice and not a defect.
findings.suggested_fix: None needed. Optionally edit the Design step 4 text so it says `remote:<campaign>` directly.
findings.acceptance: The spec Design text and worker._run_gates agree.

findings.title: Extra hardening beyond the spec (signal handling, stale git lock clearing, jobs.lock)
findings.detail: Handling SIGTERM, SIGINT and SIGHUP, clearing stale git lock files and the jobs.lock claim lock were not in the original Design. They came out of review loops, they are documented under 'As shipped' and they have tests. This is mild scope growth and it stays inside `nw worker`.
findings.suggested_fix: None needed. Keep it covered by the existing tests (test_signal_under_the_repo_lock_waits_for_the_git_and_the_lock, test_a_stale_git_ref_lock_in_the_cache_is_cleared).

ac_assessment.ac: Piping a valid header and bundle into gate-job runs the gates and emits accepted, started, one gate frame per gate (with .log, .json and .r<n> files) and done
ac_assessment.evidence: test_pass_emits_frames_and_files asserts the frame types are exactly [accepted, started, gate, done], that the files are {001-hello.log, 001-hello.json} and that the log content ran in the job tree. test_retry_ladder_sends_r1_files asserts the .r1.log and .r1.json files arrive. Code: worker.gate_job, _run_gates and gate_files.

ac_assessment.ac: A gate running `git merge-base $NW_BASE HEAD` prints the same sha as on the coordinator
ac_assessment.evidence: test_merge_base_and_base_placeholder_match_the_coordinator compares the merge-base sha with the one from the src repo and checks that `{base}` resolves to the base sha. _checkout creates refs/heads/<name> in the private clone.

ac_assessment.ac: A non-allowlisted env key gives error stage validate and nothing runs; a reused job_id gives stage claim
ac_assessment.evidence: test_env_outside_allowlist_is_refused (LD_PRELOAD: exit 3, only an error frame, the marker file is absent, no job dir). test_duplicate_job_id_is_a_claim_error (stage claim, frames.jsonl unchanged). Plus 25 parametrized bad-header cases.

ac_assessment.ac: Two concurrent jobs, same repo_key and base.name with different base.sha, each see their own base
ac_assessment.evidence: test_concurrent_jobs_see_their_own_base runs two jobs at once, synced through a barrier with slots: 2. Each log shows its own base sha both before and after the other job starts. Each job uses its own `git clone --shared` with private refs.

ac_assessment.ac: EOF mid-gate ends the gate and emits done interrupted; EOF during the slot wait emits done interrupted with no started
ac_assessment.evidence: test_eof_mid_gate_interrupts checks done interrupted and that the sleep child's pid is dead. test_eof_while_waiting_for_the_slot checks done interrupted, no started and no gate frames. _watch_stdin sets cancel and calls terminate_all.

ac_assessment.ac: With the slot held, the worker emits slot_wait and then started only once the slot frees
ac_assessment.evidence: test_held_slot_gives_slot_wait_then_started (NW_WORKER_SLOT_WAIT_EVENT_S=0.5): slot_wait is seen while 'started' is absent, and the final order is accepted, slot_wait, started, gate, done.

ac_assessment.ac: Exit 0 after done (pass, fail or interrupted), 3 after error
ac_assessment.evidence: The pass, fail, EOF and signal-mid-gate tests assert rc 0. The validate, claim, read, checkout and signal tests assert rc 3. In code, gate_job returns 0 and _fail returns EXIT_ERROR.

ac_assessment.ac: A log over 16 MiB arrives cut to 16 MiB with truncated_bytes in its sidecar
ac_assessment.evidence: test_log_over_16_mib_is_truncated: the log length equals MAX_LOG_BYTES, the tail marker is kept, the head marker is cut, and truncated_bytes equals the full size minus 16 MiB.

ac_assessment.ac: have reports commit and base after the job; after gc --keep-days 0, have reports none, cat-file -e fails, job dirs are gone, a live job's dir survives
ac_assessment.evidence: test_have_then_gc_removes_refs_objects_and_job_dirs and test_gc_during_a_live_job_keeps_its_dir (the live tree, job.lock and commit object remain). Also test_gc_reads_the_live_jobs_again_under_the_repo_lock.
test_info_json_keys asserts the exact key set: schema, protocol, version, git_sha, data_dir, git, uv, free_bytes.

ac_assessment.ac: ssh-command execs the four allowed subcommands and refuses everything else with exit 2, running nothing
ac_assessment.evidence: tests/test_worker_ssh_command.py: test_allowed_commands_are_execd (execvp patched, 6 forms) and test_refused_commands_run_nothing (metacharacters, other subcommands, `have --repo ../x`, newline tricks, empty input). worker.check_ssh_command implements the literal grammar, and own_nw avoids the path the client sent.

ac_assessment.ac: docs/WORKFLOW.md documents the mandatory dedicated user and the absolute-path key line
ac_assessment.evidence: The 'Remote gate worker' section in the diff says 'all of it is mandatory', requires a dedicated unprivileged user, and shows command="/home/user/.local/bin/nw worker ssh-command",restrict.
